def axis(s, key, wall):
    k, v = s['kappa_'+key], s['vel_'+key]

        else:
            left, right = (i-1)%n, (i+1)%n
            a[i,left] = -(k[i]+k[left])/(2*h*h)-max(v[i],0)/h
            a[i,right] = -(k[i]+k[right])/(2*h*h)-max(-v[i],0)/h
            a[i,i] = -a[i,left]-a[i,right]
    return a
